import Mathlib

-- Precondition definitions
@[reducible, simp]
def quickSort_precond (v : List Int) : Prop :=
  -- !benchmark @start precond
  True
  -- !benchmark @end precond

-- !benchmark @start auxcode
lemma flen (p : Int → Bool) (l : List Int) : (l.filter p).length ≤ l.length := by
  first
    | exact List.length_filter_le ..
    | exact (List.filter_sublist ..).length_le
    | exact List.Sublist.length_le (List.filter_sublist ..)

/-- Quick sort with a fuel parameter (structural recursion on the fuel).
    The fuel is always instantiated with the length of the list, which is
    sufficient since each partition is strictly shorter than the input. -/
def quickSortFuel : Nat → List Int → List Int
  | 0, _ => []
  | _ + 1, [] => []
  | n + 1, p :: rest =>
      quickSortFuel n (rest.filter (fun x => decide (x ≤ p))) ++
        p :: quickSortFuel n (rest.filter (fun x => !decide (x ≤ p)))
-- !benchmark @end auxcode

-- Main function definitions
def quickSort (v : List Int) (h_precond : quickSort_precond v) : List Int :=
  -- !benchmark @start code
  quickSortFuel v.length v
  -- !benchmark @end code

-- Postcondition definitions
@[reducible, simp]
def quickSort_postcond (v : List Int) (result : List Int) (h_precond : quickSort_precond v) : Prop :=
  -- !benchmark @start postcond
   List.Sorted (· ≤ ·) result ∧ result.Perm v
  -- !benchmark @end postcond

-- !benchmark @start lemma
lemma sorted_append_int (l₁ l₂ : List Int) (h1 : l₁.Sorted (· ≤ ·)) (h2 : l₂.Sorted (· ≤ ·))
    (h : ∀ x ∈ l₁, ∀ y ∈ l₂, x ≤ y) : (l₁ ++ l₂).Sorted (· ≤ ·) :=
  List.pairwise_append.mpr ⟨h1, h2, h⟩

lemma sorted_cons_int (a : Int) (l : List Int) (h1 : ∀ b ∈ l, a ≤ b)
    (h2 : l.Sorted (· ≤ ·)) : (a :: l).Sorted (· ≤ ·) :=
  List.pairwise_cons.mpr ⟨h1, h2⟩

lemma filter_perm (p : Int → Bool) (l : List Int) :
    (l.filter p ++ l.filter (fun x => !p x)).Perm l := by
  induction l with
  | nil => simp
  | cons a t ih =>
    by_cases h : p a = true
    · have h1 : (a :: t).filter p = a :: t.filter p := by
        first
          | simp [h]
          | simp [List.filter_cons, h]
          | exact List.filter_cons_of_pos h
      have h2 : (a :: t).filter (fun x => !p x) = t.filter (fun x => !p x) := by
        first
          | simp [h]
          | simp [List.filter_cons, h]
          | exact List.filter_cons_of_neg (by simp [h])
      rw [h1, h2, List.cons_append]
      exact ih.cons a
    · have h' : p a = false := by simpa using h
      have h1 : (a :: t).filter p = t.filter p := by
        first
          | simp [h']
          | simp [List.filter_cons, h']
          | exact List.filter_cons_of_neg (by simp [h'])
      have h2 : (a :: t).filter (fun x => !p x) = a :: t.filter (fun x => !p x) := by
        first
          | simp [h']
          | simp [List.filter_cons, h']
          | exact List.filter_cons_of_pos (by simp [h'])
      rw [h1, h2]
      exact List.perm_middle.trans (ih.cons a)

lemma qs_nil_eq (n : Nat) : quickSortFuel n ([] : List Int) = [] := by
  cases n with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ m => rfl

lemma qs_spec : ∀ (n : Nat) (l : List Int), l.length ≤ n →
    (quickSortFuel n l).Perm l ∧ (quickSortFuel n l).Sorted (· ≤ ·) := by
  intro n
  induction n with
  | zero =>
    intro l hl
    cases l with
    | nil =>
      rw [qs_nil_eq]
      exact ⟨List.Perm.refl _, List.Pairwise.nil⟩
    | cons a t =>
      exfalso
      simp only [List.length_cons] at hl
      omega
  | succ n ih =>
    intro l hl
    cases l with
    | nil =>
      rw [qs_nil_eq]
      exact ⟨List.Perm.refl _, List.Pairwise.nil⟩
    | cons p rest =>
      have hlen : rest.length ≤ n := by
        simp only [List.length_cons] at hl
        omega
      have hA : (rest.filter (fun x => decide (x ≤ p))).length ≤ n :=
        le_trans (flen _ _) hlen
      have hB : (rest.filter (fun x => !decide (x ≤ p))).length ≤ n :=
        le_trans (flen _ _) hlen
      obtain ⟨pA, sA⟩ := ih _ hA
      obtain ⟨pB, sB⟩ := ih _ hB
      have hEq : quickSortFuel (n + 1) (p :: rest) =
          quickSortFuel n (rest.filter (fun x => decide (x ≤ p))) ++
            p :: quickSortFuel n (rest.filter (fun x => !decide (x ≤ p))) := by
        first
          | rfl
          | simp only [quickSortFuel]
          | rw [quickSortFuel]
      have hmemA : ∀ a ∈ quickSortFuel n (rest.filter (fun x => decide (x ≤ p))), a ≤ p := by
        intro a ha
        have h3 : decide (a ≤ p) = true :=
          (List.mem_filter.mp (pA.mem_iff.mp ha)).2
        exact of_decide_eq_true h3
      have hmemB : ∀ b ∈ quickSortFuel n (rest.filter (fun x => !decide (x ≤ p))), p ≤ b := by
        intro b hb
        have h3 : (!decide (b ≤ p)) = true :=
          (List.mem_filter.mp (pB.mem_iff.mp hb)).2
        have h2 : ¬ (b ≤ p) := by
          intro hc
          simp [hc] at h3
        exact (not_le.mp h2).le
      have hfp : ((rest.filter (fun x => decide (x ≤ p))) ++
          (rest.filter (fun x => !decide (x ≤ p)))).Perm rest :=
        filter_perm (fun x => decide (x ≤ p)) rest
      constructor
      · rw [hEq]
        refine List.perm_middle.trans ?_
        exact List.Perm.cons p ((pA.append pB).trans hfp)
      · have hcons : (p :: quickSortFuel n (rest.filter (fun x => !decide (x ≤ p)))).Sorted
            (· ≤ ·) := sorted_cons_int _ _ hmemB sB
        have hcross : ∀ x ∈ quickSortFuel n (rest.filter (fun x => decide (x ≤ p))),
            ∀ y ∈ p :: quickSortFuel n (rest.filter (fun x => !decide (x ≤ p))), x ≤ y := by
          intro x hx y hy
          rcases List.mem_cons.mp hy with h | h
          · exact le_of_le_of_eq (hmemA x hx) h.symm
          · exact le_trans (hmemA x hx) (hmemB y h)
        rw [hEq]
        exact sorted_append_int _ _ sA hcons hcross
-- !benchmark @end lemma

-- Proof content
theorem quickSort_postcond_satisfied (v : List Int) (h_precond : quickSort_precond v) :
    quickSort_postcond v (quickSort v h_precond) h_precond := by
  -- !benchmark @start proof
  obtain ⟨hp, hs⟩ := qs_spec v.length v le_rfl
  exact ⟨hs, hp⟩
  -- !benchmark @end proof

## Analysis of the errors

1. **`decreasing_by` failed** for the well-founded definition (the goal shape didn't match my tactics). To eliminate all termination-proof fragility I replaced well-founded recursion by *structural recursion on a fuel parameter* (`quickSortFuel : Nat → List Int → List Int`), calling it with `v.length` as fuel. The correctness lemma is proved by induction on the fuel with the invariant `l.length ≤ n`, which is exactly the induction I needed anyway — and the fuel is always sufficient because each filtered list is no longer than the tail.

2. **`List.sorted_append` does not exist** in this Mathlib version. Since `List.Sorted r = List.Pairwise r` by definition, I prove my own `sorted_append_int` from the core lemma `List.pairwise_append`, and use `List.pairwise_cons` instead of `List.sorted_cons`.

## Analysis

**Algorithm.** Classic quicksort: for `p :: rest`, partition `rest` into `A = rest.filter (· ≤ p)` and `B = rest.filter (fun x => !(x ≤ p))`, sort each recursively, and return `qs A ++ p :: qs B`. Termination: each filtered list is no longer than `rest`, hence strictly shorter than `p :: rest`.

**Correctness.** By strong induction on the length bound `n`:

* *Permutation:* `qs A ++ p :: qs B ~ p :: (qs A ++ qs B)` (`List.perm_middle`), then `qs A ~ A`, `qs B ~ B` (IH) and `A ++ B ~ rest` (a lemma about a predicate and its negation).
* *Sortedness:* use `List.sorted_append`: both parts sorted (IH plus `List.sorted_cons` with the fact that every element of `qs B` is `≥ p`), and every element `x` of `qs A` satisfies `x ≤ p`, so `x ≤ p` and `x ≤ y` for `y ∈ qs B` by transitivity. Membership is transferred through the permutation facts (`List.Perm.mem_iff`) and read off from `List.mem_filter`.

Helper lemmas: `flen` (filter shortens), `filter_perm` (partition permutation), and the combined `qs_spec`.
